nom: ANUA Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil Mild

avis.texte: If you are afraid of getting breakouts or have gotten breakouts from cleansing oils - please read! I've tried many oil & balm cleansers (Korean, US, japanese) like Anua's original, manyo, elemis, farmacy, kose, and DHC - this mild version from Anua is my favorite and has given me the best results. Learning how to use a product like this is key to those results. When my skin is clogged, I like to apply it to a dry face and I will massage all over and then concentrate light pressure on areas like corner of my nose amd forehead to really unclog those pores. This goes on for 1-3 minutes. If youre doing it right, you'll feel the dead skin, and whiteheads unclog. It sounds like a long time but think of it as a facial massage / lymphatic drainage too. You add water to the massage when you feel you got most out, to create a milky lather, then rinse away. After, you will double cleanse with your choice of cleanser (i recommend one that foams/lathers) and really make sure you cleanse it all away!! Then follow up with your skincare. Not sure why but this formula works better for me than the original. I wish there was a mini of this version!
Used this for almost a year, trying to lessen my breakouts but it just made it worse and it just clogged pores.

avis.titre: Love this oil cleanser for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I am new to the double cleansing routine so picked this up to get started with my nee regime. I have very sensitive skin and usually have reactions to many skin products. This cleansing oil gave me no trouble at all, even on my eye area. It removes makeup and mascara easily and emulsifies in water besutifully. Rinsinf off is super easy and I am left with hudrated skin.

avis.titre: i wanted to love this so bad
avis.texte: i tried the regular heartleaf cleansing oil but didn't repurchase because it does have fragrance. i heard about the mild version and was so confident it would be a good fit, however i immediately broke out and had to return it :( while it has a very short list of ingredients, it does contain rosemary oil which can potentitally be pore clogging if you have more acne prone skin like myself. didn't love but it's ok anua i still love you

I looooove tbis stuff. I have combo skin and get build up in my T zone. I love using this on makeup days as a first step to double cleanse or on other days when I just feel oily or want to deep clean my pores. The oil really gets in there and dissolves all the little gunky stuff and gentlt exfoliates. Its so satisfying to use. Make sure to emulsify with water and rub in a bit more before removing. It leaves my skin feeling soooo soft, clean, nourished, and not stripped at all.

I loved this cleansing oil and it even removed all my waterproof make up! The best way I found was to do one pump of the cleanser and massage all over your face, and gently on the eyes, and then add a little bit of water. It emulsifies really well and removes everything. I really loved how it smelled clean, and there was no stinging or irritation on my sensitive skin a lot of times products that are " Clean "still irritate my try and eczema prone skin, but this did not. For the price I was very surprised at how great the results are! To me it feels and acts like a product you would find in a fancy day spa. I would definitely recommend this to my family and friends.
